podcast.body: This song is a sample from the first volume of Josh Homme's Desert Sessions, recorded in the summer of 1997. "This is Girl Tom Boy. That's Josh Hommie leading the first volume of his desert sessions that every changing collective of musical friends that loved to hang out and create."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 1
